_meta.description: Source of truth for App Store Connect and Game Center localizations.
_meta.instructions: Edit only the 'en' (English) fields. Leave other locales as null. Run upload_metadata.py — Claude fills missing locales and uploads everything. Filled translations are cached back into this file so re-runs are cheap.

whats_new._tone: Brief, friendly release notes. Use line breaks (\n) between bullet points.
whats_new.en: New localizations! Hex Chess now supports Armenian, Chinese Traditional, Danish, Finnish, Hebrew, Icelandic, Indonesian, Norwegian, Swedish & Turkish
whats_new.ar: توطينات جديدة! تدعم لعبة الشطرنج السداسي الآن الأرمنية والصينية التقليدية والدنماركية والفنلندية والعبرية والآيسلندية والإندونيسية والنرويجية والسويدية والتركية
whats_new.da: Nye sprog! Hexskak understøtter nu armensk, traditionelt kinesisk, dansk, finsk, hebraisk, islandsk, indonesisk, norsk, svensk og tyrkisk
whats_new.de: Neue Sprachen! Hexschach unterstützt jetzt Armenisch, Chinesisch (traditionell), Dänisch, Finnisch, Hebräisch, Isländisch, Indonesisch, Norwegisch, Schwedisch und Türkisch

whats_new.ja: 新しい言語に対応！ヘックスチェスがアルメニア語、繁体字中国語、デンマーク語、フィンランド語、ヘブライ語、アイスランド語、インドネシア語、ノルウェー語、スウェーデン語、トルコ語に対応しました
whats_new.ko: 새로운 언어 지원! 헥스 체스가 이제 아르메니아어, 중국어(번체), 덴마크어, 핀란드어, 히브리어, 아이슬란드어, 인도네시아어, 노르웨이어, 스웨덴어, 터키어를 지원합니다

whats_new.nl: Nieuwe talen! Hexschaak ondersteunt nu Armeens, traditioneel Chinees, Deens, Fins, Hebreeuws, IJslands, Indonesisch, Noors, Zweeds en Turks

whats_new.ru: Новые языки! «Гекс-шахматы» теперь поддерживают армянский, китайский традиционный, датский, финский, иврит, исландский, индонезийский, норвежский, шведский и турецкий

whats_new.zh-Hans: 全新语言支持！六角国际象棋现已支持亚美尼亚语、繁体中文、丹麦语、芬兰语、希伯来语、冰岛语、印度尼西亚语、挪威语、瑞典语和土耳其语
whats_new.zh-Hant: 全新語言支援！六角國際象棋現已支援亞美尼亞語、繁體中文、丹麥語、芬蘭語、希伯來語、冰島語、印尼語、挪威語、瑞典語和土耳其語

version_localizations._inherit_notes: description, keywords, and promotional_text default to inheriting from the most recent prior App Store version per locale. Leave 'en' (and all locales) as null to inherit. Fill in 'en' and ask Claude Code to translate when you want to override.

description._tone: Marketing copy for the App Store listing. Conversational, inviting, highlights gameplay.

keywords._tone: Comma-separated, no spaces after commas to maximize use of the 100-character limit. Search terms only.

promotional_text._tone: Short hook that appears above the description. Updateable without resubmitting a new app version.

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks the player's first win of any game.

before_earned_description._tone: Tells the player what they need to do. Imperative.

after_earned_description._tone: Celebrates the player's accomplishment. Past tense.

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks checkmating the CPU opponent.

before_earned_description._tone: Tells the player what they need to do. Imperative.

after_earned_description._tone: Celebrates the player's accomplishment. Past tense.

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks winning a multiplayer game that the player joined (rather than created).

before_earned_description._tone: Tells the player what they need to do. Imperative.

after_earned_description._tone: Celebrates the player's accomplishment. Past tense.
after_earned_description.en: You won a game you joined!

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks checkmating the opponent after capturing every one of their pieces.

before_earned_description._tone: Tells the player what they need to do. Imperative.
before_earned_description.en: Checkmate after capturing all enemy pieces.

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks marching the player's king all the way to the opposing king's starting tile.

after_earned_description._tone: Celebrates the player's accomplishment. Past tense.
after_earned_description.en: You marched your king all the way to the opposing king's starting position!

title._tone: Punchy, ideally clever. Marks promoting a pawn for the first time.
